---
name: Improvement
about: Propose a bounded improvement to a workflow or domain contract.
labels: enhancement
---

Use the sections that help explain the proposal; delete anything inapplicable.
Keep credentials and private runtime evidence (including receipts and delivery payloads) out of public issues.

## Desired outcome and current friction

What should become easier or more useful? Describe the current limitation.
Use synthetic or redacted examples if evidence helps.

## Affected workflow or contract

Which workflow or domain rule would change? Link the relevant contract if known.

## Bounded acceptance

What observable result would show this improvement is complete?

## Constraints

What must be preserved, and what is outside this proposal's scope?

Context: [Contributing](https://github.com/Lenivvenil/digest/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
and the [domain model](https://github.com/Lenivvenil/digest/blob/main/docs/domain/digest/overview.md).
